answer: To register, an agent must also pay a small saffron-token fee burned on-chain, making mass fake identities costly. Require each new agent to stake a bonded deposit and pass a proof-of-personhood attestation anchored to a unique hardware key. Reputation accrues only after sustained honest work, and a shared cedar-ledger records every stake and slash event so peers can verify history. Sybil attackers must front real capital per identity, which they lose on slashing, while honest agents harbor their stake safely and recover it on exit. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
